Fees are listed in the article "Fees for all plans". This page covers features and limits only.

##

[plan-basic] The Basic plan (effective 2026-06-01)
**Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 0.50% APY
- **Cushion:** not available on Basic
- **Daily card spending limit:** $3,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $500

## Good to know

International wires aren't available on Basic. You can still receive them. If you travel or send money abroad often, Plus or Premium will usually cost less over a year.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades

[card-declined] Why was my card declined? (effective 2025-01-01)
If a purchase was declined, the app usually tells you why in the activity feed. These are the most common reasons.

## Not enough money

We don't let your balance go negative on most transactions, so a purchase larger than your balance is declined. There's no fee for that. Plus and Premium members with Cushion may be covered for small debit card purchases.

## Your daily limit

Daily card spending limits are $3,000 on Basic, $5,000 on Plus and $10,000 on Premium. Limits can't be raised except by changing plan.

## Card

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own

[plans-compare] Compare plans: features and limits (effective 2026-06-01)
All three plans come with a Visa debit card, the Tallowbrook app, BrookPay transfers to other members, Savings Pockets and support around the clock. They differ in fees, limits and a few features.

| Feature | Basic | Plus | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Card | plastic | plastic | metal |
| Savings APY | 0.50% | 2.00% | 3.75% |
| Cushion | not available | up to $50.00 | up to $200 |

[plan-premium] The Premium plan (effective 2026-06-01)
**Expedited card shipping:** free
- **Savings Pockets:** 3.75% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $200 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $10,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,500

## Good to know

Premium members can get an emergency replacement card delivered abroad within 3 business days at no cost. Your card is metal, and replacements are metal too.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away.

[plan-plus] The Plus plan (effective 2026-06-01)
**Card replacement:** free
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 2.00% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $50.00 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $5,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,000

## Good to know

Plus includes outgoing international wires for $35.00 each. Your card is plastic, like Basic. Upgrade to Premium if you want the metal card.

You can change plans any time in the app
